response.sql: WITH project_rates AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, SUM(s.gbsize)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(s.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans s INNER JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bench FROM project_rates) SELECT pr.arcref, pr.fundflux, pr.rate, pr.rate - b.bench AS gap FROM project_rates pr CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE pr.rate > b.bench ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10;
